Mod.Name: FF8 Steam Deck Button Glyphs
Mod.Author: todi
Mod.Description:
Shows the Steam Deck buttons (A, B, X, Y, L1/R1, L2/R2, View, Menu) wherever FF8 names a button, instead of "B1", "B2", ... The glyphs follow your bindings from the in-game Config screen.
Requires the English Steam 2013 version (FF8_EN.exe) or the Remastered edition, with FFNx. Turns on FFNx's ff8_use_gamepad_icons. With AxlRose's WIP (UI on): place this mod above it in the list.

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: 0.9: button glyphs are smaller and sharp-edged, so they no longer overlap the next line of text. Auto Sort now places this mod above AxlRose's WIP. 0.8: first catalog release, textures only.
